title: Windows Server Enterprise Infrastructure
description:
Built an enterprise-style Windows Server environment around Active Directory, DNS, DHCP and IPAM.

• Deployed AD DS with multiple domain controllers
• Configured DNS and DHCP for centralized management
• Implemented IPAM for IP address tracking
• Created Group Policies for security compliance

title: Redundant DNS with Master-Slave Replication
description:
Implemented a redundant DNS architecture on Red Hat Linux with master/slave replication for service resilience.

• Configured BIND DNS server on RHEL
• Set up master-slave replication
• Tested failover scenarios
• Documented configuration and troubleshooting steps

title: Linux Mail Server with Backup & Recovery
description:
Built a Red Hat Linux mail-server environment with backup and recovery considerations for continuity.

• Deployed Postfix and Dovecot
• Configured SMTP relay with authentication
• Implemented automated backup scripts
• Tested recovery procedures

title: Departmental VLAN Network Design
description:
Designed departmental segmentation and secure inter-VLAN communication using switching, routing and access-control concepts.

• Configured VLANs for multiple departments
• Implemented inter-VLAN routing with Router-on-a-Stick
• Applied ACLs for security between departments
• Documented network topology and addressing plan

title: Secure Samba File Sharing
description:
Configured secure network file sharing on Red Hat Linux with permissions and access-control considerations.

• Deployed Samba server on RHEL
• Configured user-level access controls
• Integrated with Windows Active Directory
• Implemented audit logging
